findings.evidence: The complete theorem statement embeds wikilinks to definitions and results inside its hypotheses and conclusions. These links must follow the complete Statement section; the theorem remains intelligible, so the defect is nonfatal.

The hypotheses and norm conclusion are interrupted by title-like parentheticals naming the dual-space and operator-norm definitions: '(The dual space X^* of a normed space and its dual norm)' and '(The operator norm as the least bound and as the unit-sphere or unit-ball supremum)'. They are editorial residue rather than mathematical hypotheses.

The quoted formulation ends with a separate '(Choice function).' parenthetical after the complete sentence 'Every family of nonempty sets has a choice function'. This is citation-like residue and interrupts the definition's presentation.

The complete definition includes inline wikilinks such as [[def-smooth-manifold]] and [[def-smooth-embedding]]. Under the uninterrupted-definition rule those links must be moved after the full Definition section.
The normal/conormal bundle definition embeds wikilinks within its complete formulation. Move those links after the full Definition section.
The tubular-neighbourhood definition embeds wikilinks in the formulation of its input data and map. Move those links after the full Definition section.
The covering-map definition embeds wikilinks to the continuous-map, homeomorphism, and disjoint-union definitions inside the formulation. Move those links after the complete Definition section.
The definition embeds links to the covering-map and simply-connected definitions before the defining sentence is complete. Move them after the complete Definition section.

The deck-transformation and deck-group definition embeds wikilinks to covering-space isomorphisms, groups, and group actions inside its two defining sentences. Move the links after the complete Definition section.

The definition's explanatory paragraph contains inline links to the pullback metric and diffeomorphism definitions. Those links interrupt the complete Definition section and belong in its following references section.
The dual-space definition embeds wikilinks to normed spaces, bounded operators, and algebraic duals within the defining formulation. Move these links after the full Definition section.
The operator-norm definition embeds wikilinks within its formulation, including a link to boundedness and a link to a real-field property. Move these links after the complete Definition section.
The bounded-linear-operator formulation embeds wikilinks to real and complex normed spaces and linear maps. Move them after the full Definition section.
The choice-function definition embeds wikilinks to functions, power sets, and set difference inside the defining sentence. Move those links after the complete Definition section.
The theorem statement inserts the wikilink [[def-countable-choice]] into its hypothesis. Move the link after the complete Statement section.
The complete group theorem statement embeds wikilinks to braid, isotopy, and permutation definitions/results inside the formulation. Move them after the Statement section.
The closure-of-a-geometric-braid definition contains inline wikilinks throughout its complete formulation. Move them after the Definition section.
The theorem statement contains an inline wikilink to the sectional-curvature definition. Move it after the complete Statement section.
